authority: Latest GitHub main plus MOTION_DEFECT_BACKLOG.json. This file defines shared HOLD-repair execution for all terminals.
objective: Convert HOLD_VISUAL_INTEGRITY pairs to VERIFIED accurately without cross-terminal collision or premature formal promotion.

coordination.frontTerminal: Claim lowest available MOTION issue number first.
coordination.backTerminal: Claim highest available MOTION issue number first.
coordination.releaseRule: Clear claim only after VERIFIED or a new evidence-backed HOLD diagnosis has been committed.

repairUnit.scope: One actionKey pair = hit + rebound. A phase that looks fixed cannot be promoted if the other phase still fails pair-level integrity.
repairUnit.rediagnosisRule: If local repair passes machine QA but pair still fails human visual QA, stop local retries and rewrite root cause at pair level before moving on.

mandatoryStaticGates: single coherent active arm/hand/stick per active limb
stick continuity from grip to tip
fixed drum composite contact and strike semantics
hit and rebound must both pass as one pair

promotion.onStaticFail: HOLD_VISUAL_INTEGRITY with exact visible reason and next permitted repair scope.
promotion.onRuntimeFail: HOLD with exact runtime reason; do not disguise as static pass.

prohibited: whole-character redraw for a local defect
editing locked head/torso/stool/legs unless explicitly diagnosed as active defect
formal PNG promotion from machine QA alone
overwriting or cancelling another terminal's active claim
